Configuration for the [Myra](https://www.myrasecurity.com/en/) DNS provider.

See the [lego documentation](https://go-acme.github.io/lego/dns/myra/) for full details.

```yaml
letsEncrypt:
  dnsProvider: "myra"
  dnsCredentials:
    # MYRA_API_KEY: API key
    apiKey: ""
    # MYRA_API_SECRET: API secret
    apiSecret: ""
    # MYRA_POLLING_INTERVAL: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 20)
    pollingInterval: ""
    # MYRA_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 600)
    propagationTimeout: ""
    # MYRA_TTL: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)
    ttl: ""
```

Credentials are passed directly to lego using strong types and are never written to the process environment.
You may also use the raw lego environment-variable names as keys instead of the normalized names.
